results.title: [HIRING] Bot creator for E-commerce platform (Lazada)
results.description:
Hi there! I’m looking for someone to help me create a bot for an e commerce platform to automate purchases. Please send me a DM if you have experience with developing such e-commerce bots

Budget : $50-90 USD

I require other programmes to be developed as well which is open for discussion.
